author: Tyler Haughn
title: ISP: Wayne County man attempted to solicit children; found with CSAM - NewsBreak
text:
By Tyler Haughn ,
4 hours ago
FOX59/CBS4 has requested a mugshot of James Slonaker, which has not been provided as of this article’s publication. The mugshot will be added once it is released.
WAYNE COUNTY, Ind. -- A Wayne County man is facing child exploitation and several other felony charges related to child sex crimes.
On Thursday, Indiana State Police announced the arrest of 41-year-old James Slonaker following an investigation that was initiated eight months ago after the Indiana Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force received a tip accusing Slonaker of child solicitation.
Following the conclusion of the investigation, ISP said authorities executed a search warrant at Slonaker's residence in Cambridge City on Sept. 30. Slonaker was placed under arrest and transported to the Wayne County Jail on the following preliminary charges:
Child Exploitation ( Level 4 Felony ) Child Solicitation ( Level 5 Felony ) Possession of Child Sex Abuse Material ( Level 6 Felony ) The Indiana State Police Internet Crimes Against Children Unit, K9 Titus, Indiana State Police Digital Forensics Unit, and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security Investigations assisted with the investigation.
